locationErrors.DENIED: Location access is blocked for this site. Allow it from the lock or location icon next to the address bar (on a phone: Settings › Location › your browser), then try again.
locationErrors.UNAVAILABLE: Your device could not work out where you are. Switch on location — and Wi-Fi, which makes it more precise — then try again.
locationErrors.TIMEOUT: Finding your location took too long. Step near a window or outside and try again.
locationErrors.UNSUPPORTED: This browser cannot share its location here (it needs a secure https page). Try another browser, or use the biometric device.

sites.title: Attendance sites
sites.subtitle: Where staff and students of this campus may mark themselves in and out when the geofence is on. Add one per building or campus — a circle, or an outline for an odd-shaped campus.
sites.noSites: No sites — staff of this campus are checked against the other campuses’ sites, if any.
sites.cornersHint: In order around the campus, one per line (3 to {{max}}). Click them on the map, walk to each corner and press “Add my location”, or paste them from a maps app.
sites.addCorner: Add my location as a corner
sites.standHint: Stand at the building and press “Use my location”, or paste the coordinates from a maps app.
sites.fixAccuratePoor: Fix accurate to ±{{distance}} — try again outdoors for a better one

siteMap.hintPolygon: Click the map to add corners in order around the campus; drag a corner to move it, click it to remove it.
siteMap.hintCircle: Click the map or drag the pin to set the centre; the slider sets the radius.
siteMap.cornerTitle: Corner {{n}} — drag to move, click to remove
siteMap.maxCorners: {{max}} corners is the most an outline can have.
siteMap.badCorners: A line in the corner list below is not “latitude, longitude” — fix it to see and edit the outline on the map.

maps.siteFailed: The map could not load — type the coordinates below instead.

self.title: Punch in & punch out
self.onCampus: Works only on the campus — your location is checked once, when you press the button. Nothing is tracked.
self.noSites: The campus location isn't set up yet — ask the office.
self.flagged: Outside the campus — the office will check it
self.parentLogin: Students check in from their own login on the student app — not from a parent's phone.
self.subtitle: Mark the time you arrive and leave.
self.subtitleGeo: Mark the time you arrive and leave — from the campus.
self.privacy: Your location is read only when you punch or tap “Show where I am”. Nothing is tracked.

where.noSitesSub: Ask the office to add it
where.unknownSub: It is checked when you punch
